name: Calculator
description: Provides a block that displays an interactive calculator.
project_description:
The Calculator Block Module provides a block to display simple calculator on your website with predefined layouts where you can also override the default css layouts on your custom theme.

 We can also override the calculator template and css for design layout with abailable variables on the twig template.

 We can copy the template file from templates/calculator-block.html.twig and place on your theme themplate directory and customize the html and implement your own layout with custom css.

 Support 
 Please post bug reports, feature requests and support requests to the Calculator Block module issue queue . If you met any problems with this module - feel free to create an issue.

 Back to top 

 Demo 
 
 Go to https://simplytest.me/project/calculator . 
 Click "Launch Sandbox". 
 Install Drupal as normal. 
 Enable "Calculator Block" module, and any optional modules you wish to try out. 
 Go to structure > Block layout 
 Click on the place button wheren you want to add the calculator 
 Configure the block title, Calculator Layout and visibility as your requirement 
 
 

 
 Installation and download 
 Installation with Composer: 

 composer require 'drupal/calculator' 

 
 Download latest version
